jobs.title: Data Science Manager
jobs.description:
Hyundai Capital America (HCA) helps people move forward. Through Hyundai Motor Finance, Genesis Finance, and Kia Finance, we deliver innovative financing, leasing, and insurance solutions to more than 3 million customers and businesses nationwide.

We’re a company driven by growth, innovation, and people. At HCA, you’ll find opportunities to build new skills, expand your career, and make a real impact—while working in a diverse, inclusive, and values‑driven environment. We’re proud to support our communities through volunteerism, philanthropy, and engaged Employee Resource Groups.

If you’re looking for a fast‑paced, collaborative workplace where your ideas matter, join us as we lead the future of financing freedom of movement. Apply today.

What You Will Do

The Data Science Manager is an experienced individual contributor who independently builds, validates and deploys machine learning, AI and statistical models that support business needs across the enterprise. Working under general direction, the role owns assigned AI solutions from problem framing and data preparation through model development, evaluation and production, applying LLM-based and agentic AI techniques alongside traditional machine learning. The role partners with business, product, technology, AI governance, security and compliance teams to deliver well-governed solutions with measurable results.

How You Will Make An Impact

Design, develop and deploy machine learning, AI and statistical models for assigned business problems; define success metrics with business partners and measure impact through testing and analysis.
Build and evaluate LLM-based and agentic AI solutions, including retrieval-augmented generation and AI agents, applying established evaluation, guardrail and quality standards.
Deploy models into production and maintain their performance, including training and inference pipelines, versioning, and monitoring for drift and accuracy.
Partner with business, product and technology teams, AI architecture and governance, security and compliance to scope use cases, access data, document solutions for the AI catalogue, and meet responsible-AI and regulatory requirements.
Contribute to team modeling standards and reusable patterns, conduct peer code and model reviews, and provide technical guidance as needed.

What You Will Bring To The Role

5-7 years of hands-on experience building machine learning, AI and statistical models and deploying them to production including building LLM-based or agentic AI solutions; equivalent project experience may be considered.
Experience independently managing projects or workstreams of moderate scope and complexity.
Automotive or financial services industry experience preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science or AI, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related quantitative discipline; equivalent related work experience may be considered.
Master’s degree in a quantitative field preferred.
Thorough working knowledge of applied machine learning, AI and statistics, including model design, evaluation and validation.
Working experience with LLMs, agent development, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, and AI evaluation and guardrails.
Proficiency in Python, PySpark and SQL, and common machine learning and LLM application frameworks.
Experience building and deploying models on AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock) or a similar cloud platform, with working knowledge of MLOps/LLMOps/AgentOps practices such as model registry and monitoring.
Ability to translate business problems into well-scoped data science solutions and explain model results and limitations to non-technical stakeholders.
Understanding of responsible AI and model governance practices in a regulated environment.
Strong analytical, communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities.

WE TAKE CARE OF OUR PEOPLE

At HCA, our people drive our success. That’s why we offer a competitive rewards package that supports your health, financial future, and overall wellbeing—at work and beyond.

Benefits Highlights

Hybrid Flexibility – 4 days onsite, 1 day remote
Vehicle perks – monthly vehicle allowance plus purchase and lease discounts
Comprehensive health coverage – medical, dental, and vision plans
Employer-funded HSA contributions to help reduce healthcare costs
401(k) with company match and immediate vesting from day one
100% company-paid life and disability insurance
Wellbeing benefits including fitness and health resources
Leadership programs and career development that support continuous learning
Paid Volunteer Time Off and a company charitable donation in your honor

jobs.description:
Overview

Intuit’s Identity Data Science Team is looking for a hands-on Senior Data Scientist who is a creative problem solver with a passion to deliver advanced data-driven solutions. You will work alongside other Data Scientists, Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Architects, and Program Managers to evolve Intuit’s Identity capabilities within Intuit’s Platform. As a key member of the data science team, you will have a strong track record of combining advanced analytical skills with exceptional business and entrepreneurial acumen. You will also have an ownership mindset with a strong willingness to take on new challenges with enthusiasm.

This is an exciting time to join the Identity Data Science Team at Intuit as we are building many new cutting-edge capabilities. These include a next-generation Verified Identity Network, password-less authentication powered through passkeys, Generative AI experiences, modern and sophisticated fraud prevention, centralized user and account management, and much more. Data is central to Intuit’s decision-making process, and data scientists are a critical component to evangelize data-driven decisions as we transform and scale Identity capabilities to power Intuit’s future growth.

Responsibilities

Partner with cross functional teams to drive data-backed decisions and actionable insights
Use a hypothesis-driven approach to drive design, implementation, and analysis of A/B experiments. Then provide executive level recommendations on next steps based on the test results and insights
Communicate analytical findings and recommendations in a clear and concise way to non-technical audiences, both in writing and through oral presentations
Provide guidance and thought leadership to business leaders and stakeholders on how best to harness available data to support business goals
Ensure data collection and data processing is optimized to provide crystal-clear visibility into the impact and value of new initiatives and product releases
Identify opportunities for developing new data sources, and provide technical leadership around making those data sources high-quality and broadly available
Pursue data quality, troubleshoot data anomalies, validate data accuracy, and drive issues to resolution
Share responsibility for owning and maintaining the data science backlog, connecting directly with partners and stakeholders to communicate and align on priorities

Qualifications

5+ years of experience working in web, marketing, product, analytics, or other related data science fields with a strong knowledge of statistics
Exceptional SQL skills and experience working with granular web and native clickstream data
Highly proficient in Tableau, Qliksense, Quicksight or similar software
Exceptional ability to take initiative, be a self-starter, and solve problems
Outstanding communications skills with the ability to influence decision makers and build consensus with stakeholder teams
Proactive and inquisitive learner who seeks out and capitalizes on opportunities for change that enhance the business, rather than reacting to circumstances
Strong organizational skills, time management, accountability, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously to meet objectives and key deadlines
Love for mentoring and guiding others on best practices. Passionate about the advancement of the whole team
Experience in programming languages, automation tools, and stats packages (e.g. Python) is a plus; comfortable creating re-usable data pipelines

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

jobs.description:
Description

Summary

Why It's a Great Opportunity:
In this role with Pierce County’s Surface Water Management (SWM) Division, you will lead teams in capital project delivery for engineering design, environmental permitting, right of way concerns, construction management, and project oversight. Your experience and knowledge in surface water projects will be utilized in areas of floodplains, water resources, water quality and urban stormwater applications. You and your teams will be working with internal employees as well as contractors utilizing Bluebeam, GIS, AutoCAD, Hydraulic and Hydrologic modeling, and other computer applications.

Why It's a Great Department:
PPW stewards a healthy and vibrant community by collaboratively planning and investing in our people, infrastructure, systems, and policies. PPW’s team has more than 800 members that collaborate, innovate and inspire in performing essential services to the community. The department is responsible for the County road and levee systems, sewer systems, airports, ferries, building permits, environmental review, sustainability, community planning, and code enforcement - just to name a few!

Learn more about Planning and Public Works here.

How to be Successful in the Role:
Your success in this role will come from bringing a positive attitude, strong leadership skills, a priority for customer service, sound engineering judgment, and a willingness to keep learning. You will be most successful by communicating clearly, making thoughtful independent decisions, supporting your teammates, and building strong working relationships with your teammates, consultants, County staff, project stakeholders, and the broader Pierce County community.

Your Future in this Role:
You will have access to professional development through robust online learning and other training opportunities throughout your career to ensure your success. This position has multiple career growth and promotional opportunities in Pierce County to build on a great career while directly impacting the communities in Pierce County.

Core Daily Responsibilities

Manages assigned resources to complete work and secure approval of major engineering programs using acceptable methods of planning and management.
Provides leadership and direction to the professional and technical staff responsible for implementing a major engineering program; delegates authority to personnel commensurate with responsibility and ensures the proper functioning of assigned staff.
Schedules and assigns employees; approves or denies use of sick leave, vacation leave, and overtime.
Trains and educates staff on criteria and standards. Provides engineering guidance to staff and makes engineering recommendations to County officials and other departments.
Assists in developing recruitment and selection processes. Conducts final interviews; recommends individuals for hire.
Completes reviews and evaluations of subordinate employee job performance. Initiates disciplinary action when necessary. Responds to grievances at the first level.
Sets the team’s goals and objectives and participates in the development of the division’s goals and objectives.

A classification description with a more detailed list of essential functions can be found here.

Minimum Qualifications

Nine years of progressively responsible, broad based civil engineering experience is required.
A bachelor’s degree from an ABET accredited program in civil engineering, or a closely related field, may be substituted for experience on a year for year basis, up to four years.
Professional Engineers licensed in another state must be able to obtain licensure by the State of Washington within six months of employment.
A resume and cover letter are required for this position.
A valid driver's license is required.

As a condition of employment, the applicant will need to authorize and complete a background check. Information received from the background check is reviewed case-by-case and will not necessarily remove an applicant from consideration.

Supplemental Information

How To Apply

Complete and submit a detailed online Pierce County Employment Application by selecting “APPLY” above or visiting www.piercecountywa.gov/jobs .
If you have questions about this opportunity, email the Recruitment Team at PCHRRecruit@piercecountywa.gov and include the job number and title.
Individuals who need accommodation in the application or interview process may contact Human Resources at (253) 798-7480 at least two days prior to the need.

Some applicants may receive short notice to participate in additional selection steps, which may include assessments, phone screens, or interviews.

Upon offer, compensation is based on a range of job-related factors, including the requirements of the role, your skills and experience, and internal pay equity.

Pierce County is committed to fostering a Welcoming Workplace where employees are supported, respected, and able to thrive. We believe a strong public workforce is representative of the community it serves and that fair and just access to opportunity strengthens public service.

Guided by the County Executive’s Forward Together mission, Pierce County works to build communities that are safe, welcoming, and connected. This same commitment shapes how we recruit, develop, and retain our employees. County employees make a direct and visible impact in the lives of residents every day, and we invite you to join us in helping keep Pierce County a place people are proud to call home.

At Amgen, if you feel like youre part of something bigger, its because you are. Our shared missionto serve patients living with serious illnessesdrives all that we do.

Since 1980, weve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the worlds toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, youll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, youll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Sr. Scientist Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Proteomics

What You Will Do

Lets do this. Letschange the world.

Amgen is seeking a hands-on bioinformatician to develop computational tools and data infrastructure to support the Discovery Proteomics Group. The successful candidate will combine strong scientific expertise in proteomics, bioinformatics, and drug discovery with software engineering skills to understand experimental and discovery needs and translate them into fit-for-purpose computational solutions. In this vital role, they will conduct statistical analysis, data ingestion, database and tool development, and computational pipeline implementation for proteomics data to support biomarker discovery, target evaluation, experimental design, and mechanism-of-action studies. The successful candidate will join the Discovery Proteomics group at our South San Francisco campus.

Key Responsibilities

This role will enable Amgens preclinical pipeline through the delivery of innovative technologies and technical expertise. Responsibilities will include the development and implementation of data analysis, management, and visualization strategies for complex datasets generated by mass spectrometry and other technologies. The successful candidate will be expected to work closely with scientists from different functions and therapeutic areas, deliver and present analysis results to key stakeholders, collaborate across both genomic and proteomic platforms for data integration and mining, and utilize available external resources where appropriate.

Working knowledge of Unix/Linux and cloud computing (AWS) environments.

At Domino, we build solutions that help the largest, highly regulated organizations adopt AI to accelerate mission-critical use cases. Our platform integrates a streamlined model and app development environment, advanced model, agent, and app hosting capabilities, and novel governance capabilities providing regulator-ready AI at scale. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for over a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. In the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai

What We Are Building

Domino Data Lab is looking for an Account Manager to own and grow relationships with some of our most strategic enterprise customers.

You will own a focused portfolio of large, complex customers, with responsibility for the long-term health, retention, and growth of each account. That means understanding how customers are using Domino today, where we can deliver additional value, and how to expand our presence across business units, use cases, and executive stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who thinks like an owner of the customer's business. You should be comfortable building executive relationships, engaging directly with technical practitioners, developing multi-year account strategies, and working across Domino to ensure we deliver on our commitments.

Own the commercial performance, retention, and expansion of a focused portfolio of strategic enterprise customers.

Build strong relationships across technical, business, and executive leadership, establishing multiple champions and sponsors within each account.

Understand how customers are using Domino, where they are realizing value, and what is required to expand adoption across the enterprise.
Proactively identify and develop expansion opportunities across new business units, use cases, and stakeholders.
Own renewal strategy and commercial negotiations, balancing customer outcomes with long-term account growth.
Lead complex expansion opportunities from discovery and qualification through negotiation and close.
Partner closely with Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Professional Services, Product, Partnerships, Legal, and Deal Desk to coordinate customer engagement and execution.
Maintain clear account plans, qualified pipeline, accurate forecasts, and visibility into risks and opportunities across your portfolio.
Serve as the commercial point of accountability for your customers, ensuring Domino operates as a coordinated, strategic partner.

Demonstrated success retaining and expanding large enterprise customers, including closing seven-figure software transactions.
A track record of building multi-year account strategies and creating expansion opportunities rather than relying on existing demand.

jobs.description:
About Us

The people of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSK) are united by a singular mission: ending cancer for life. Our specialized care teams provide personalized, compassionate, expert care to patients of all ages. Informed by basic research done at our Sloan Kettering Institute, scientists across MSK collaborate to conduct innovative translational and clinical research that is driving a revolution in our understanding of cancer as a disease and improving the ability to prevent, diagnose, and treat it. MSK is dedicated to training the next generation of scientists and clinicians, who go on to pursue our mission at MSK and around the globe.

Exciting opportunity at MSK: Join the Andy Minn Lab
as a Research Technician!

The Minn Lab
studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms that shape anti-tumor immunity and cancer immunotherapy resistance, with the goal of translating these discoveries into new therapeutic strategies.

We are seeking a motivated Research Technician with relevant laboratory experience to support studies in tumor immunology, functional genomics, and therapeutic resistance. Working closely with Marco Vincenzo Russo, Scientific Research Lead
, and the Minn Lab research team, the technician will support molecular and cellular experiments and in vivo tumor studies.

Role Overview

About The Role

Marketing at Envoy runs on a mix of product-led signups, inbound demand and outbound motions across several products. You'll be the person who tells us which of those actually create pipeline and revenue — and you'll build the data foundation that makes the answer trustworthy.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll write production SQL and dbt models, not just query tables someone else built. You'll sit with Marketing and RevOps leadership as their analytical partner, and with the Data team as a builder who ships to the warehouse.

This is an onsite position that requires at least 5 days a week (Monday - Friday) in our San Francisco HQ office.

You will

You'll work like a forward-deployed engineer embedded in Marketing: sit with the team, find the problem, and ship the data product that solves it — on AWS, in production, end to end.

Own the marketing data platform on AWS. Build and run marketing pipelines across Redshift, S3, Glue, Lambda and Iceberg tables, with infrastructure defined in Terraform and deployed through GitHub Actions.
Model the funnel in dbt. Ship tested staging, intermediate and mart models for lead → MQL → SQL → opportunity → closed-won, plus semantic models others self-serve from.
Build attribution as a product. Design multi-touch attribution across web, paid, events, email and outbound, run it as scheduled jobs in Airflow, and expose it through governed tables and APIs.
Ship internal apps, not just dashboards. Build lightweight tools Marketing uses daily — campaign ROI explorers, lead-routing consoles, self-serve query apps — on AWS Amplify, Lambda and API Gateway with Cognito/Okta auth.
Build serverless data APIs. Expose warehouse metrics to apps, Slack and AI agents through Lambda-backed endpoints and MCP servers, with least-privilege IAM.
Close the loop with reverse ETL. Sync scores, segments and product signals from the warehouse back into Salesforce, Marketo and Outreach so Sales and Marketing act on them.
Engineer the event lake. Join Segment product events in S3/Iceberg to CRM records to measure product-qualified leads and PLG conversion at scale.
Build lead scoring and intent models. Turn product usage, firmographic and job-change signals into scores in Python or Databricks, then deploy and monitor them in production.
Run experiments and measure spend. Design A/B and holdout tests, and report CAC, payback and channel ROI with Finance.
Use AI to move faster. Build with Claude Code and LLM tooling to prototype apps, generate models and automate analysis, with the rigor to verify the output.
Keep it reliable. Own source freshness, data tests, CI checks, cost and monitoring so a broken pipeline never reaches a board deck.

You have

5+ years in analytics, with at least 2 focused on marketing, growth or go-to-market analytics at a B2B SaaS company.
Expert SQL: window functions, CTE-first style, query performance on a columnar warehouse (Redshift, Snowflake or BigQuery), and the judgment to spot a fan-out join before it reaches a dashboard.
Production dbt experience: you've built layered models, written tests, and shipped through code review and CI.
Fluency in Python for analysis and statistics (pandas, statsmodels or similar), including experiment design and causal inference basics.
Deep familiarity with marketing and sales data: Salesforce objects (leads, contacts, campaigns, opportunities), marketing automation (Marketo or HubSpot), web and product event tracking (Segment or similar).
Working knowledge of attribution approaches and their trade-offs, plus funnel and cohort analysis.
Comfort with Git, pull requests and the command line.
A track record of influencing decisions: you can explain a model's assumptions to a CMO in two sentences and defend them under questioning.

Nice to have

Experience with Airflow or another orchestrator, and with ingestion tools such as Fivetran or Estuary.
Semantic layer or metrics-layer experience (dbt Semantic Layer, Omni, Looker).
Data lake experience: Iceberg, Spectrum, Athena or Spark.
Lead scoring, propensity or marketing-mix modeling.
Exposure to sales engagement and revenue intelligence data (Outreach, Gong) or job-change signals.
Experience using LLMs and AI tools to speed up analytics work, with the rigor to check their output.

We hope this problem space excites you and we hope you're ready to come sweat the details with us – we have a lot of customers counting on us! And it certainly won't be easy.

Learn more at envoy.com

About The Role

Marketing at Envoy runs on a mix of product-led signups, inbound demand and outbound motions across several products. You'll be the person who tells us which of those actually create pipeline and revenue — and you'll build the data foundation that makes the answer trustworthy.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll write production SQL and dbt models, not just query tables someone else built. You'll sit with Marketing and RevOps leadership as their analytical partner, and with the Data team as a builder who ships to the warehouse.

This is an onsite position that requires at least 5 days a week (Monday - Friday) in our San Francisco HQ office.

You will

You'll work like a forward-deployed engineer embedded in Marketing: sit with the team, find the problem, and ship the data product that solves it — on AWS, in production, end to end.

Own the marketing data platform on AWS. Build and run marketing pipelines across Redshift, S3, Glue, Lambda and Iceberg tables, with infrastructure defined in Terraform and deployed through GitHub Actions.
Model the funnel in dbt. Ship tested staging, intermediate and mart models for lead → MQL → SQL → opportunity → closed-won, plus semantic models others self-serve from.
Build attribution as a product. Design multi-touch attribution across web, paid, events, email and outbound, run it as scheduled jobs in Airflow, and expose it through governed tables and APIs.
Ship internal apps, not just dashboards. Build lightweight tools Marketing uses daily — campaign ROI explorers, lead-routing consoles, self-serve query apps — on AWS Amplify, Lambda and API Gateway with Cognito/Okta auth.
Build serverless data APIs. Expose warehouse metrics to apps, Slack and AI agents through Lambda-backed endpoints and MCP servers, with least-privilege IAM.
Close the loop with reverse ETL. Sync scores, segments and product signals from the warehouse back into Salesforce, Marketo and Outreach so Sales and Marketing act on them.
Engineer the event lake. Join Segment product events in S3/Iceberg to CRM records to measure product-qualified leads and PLG conversion at scale.
Build lead scoring and intent models. Turn product usage, firmographic and job-change signals into scores in Python or Databricks, then deploy and monitor them in production.
Run experiments and measure spend. Design A/B and holdout tests, and report CAC, payback and channel ROI with Finance.
Use AI to move faster. Build with Claude Code and LLM tooling to prototype apps, generate models and automate analysis, with the rigor to verify the output.
Keep it reliable. Own source freshness, data tests, CI checks, cost and monitoring so a broken pipeline never reaches a board deck.

You have

5+ years in analytics, with at least 2 focused on marketing, growth or go-to-market analytics at a B2B SaaS company.
Expert SQL: window functions, CTE-first style, query performance on a columnar warehouse (Redshift, Snowflake or BigQuery), and the judgment to spot a fan-out join before it reaches a dashboard.
Production dbt experience: you've built layered models, written tests, and shipped through code review and CI.
Fluency in Python for analysis and statistics (pandas, statsmodels or similar), including experiment design and causal inference basics.
Deep familiarity with marketing and sales data: Salesforce objects (leads, contacts, campaigns, opportunities), marketing automation (Marketo or HubSpot), web and product event tracking (Segment or similar).
Working knowledge of attribution approaches and their trade-offs, plus funnel and cohort analysis.
Comfort with Git, pull requests and the command line.

They may not perform any test involving the quantitative measurement of specimens or reagents, conduct mathematical calculations related to test results, perform instrument calibration, or monitor or interpret quality control data used to assess test system performance. Unlicensed personnel shall not participate in any phase of testing that involves result generation, interpretation, verification, or reporting.

All duties must be performed under the direct and constant supervision of a physician and surgeon or a licensed laboratory professional, as defined by California regulations.

Unlicensed laboratory personnel may perform approved activities including specimen collection (patient preparation, labeling, handling, processing, preservation, transportation, and storage), assisting licensed personnel, preparing and storing reagents and culture media, assisting with preventive maintenance and troubleshooting (without calibration or performance verification), and supporting quality control procedures (without interpretation of results). Specimen collection involving venipuncture or skin puncture may only be performed if the individual holds appropriate California phlebotomy certification (e.g., CPT I or CPT II) or other qualifying license, as required by law.

Job Description

Join Dr. Hsin-Jung Yang and their research group as a Postdoctoral Scientist!

The Biomedical Imaging Research Institute (BIRI) is an interdisciplinary research program dedicated to developing and applying state‑of-the-art imaging technologies to today’s most pressing translational research and clinical questions. Our team collaborates closely with physicians and leading imaging researchers worldwide, uniting technical and clinical expertise in cardiology, neurology and oncology. We prioritize educating and training future imaging leaders.

The mission of the Yang Lab is to develop advanced imaging solutions for pathological activities in the heart and noninvasively detect, diagnose and monitor cardiovascular diseases. The team has developed cutting-edge MRI technologies, which include a needleless method for myocardial ischemia detection named cardiac fMRI (cfMRI). cfMRI utilizes oxygenation-sensitive MRI signal and controlled coronary artery stimulations to detect impaired coronary artery function without ionizing radiation, exogenous contrast agents and pharmacological stress agents. The needleless approach provides millions of patients with potential myocardial ischemic diseases a minimum risk solution for examining their coronary circulation without the potential harm from the standard clinical exams. To learn more, please visit Yang Lab | Cedars-Sinai.

Are you ready to be a part of breakthrough research?

Working independently but in close cooperation and consultation with Dr. Yang and other Research Scientists, the Postdoctoral Scientist will perform routine and complex laboratory procedures throughout the training period.
